A young [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''senator''' was appointed to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and in his naivete he accidentally offended several [[Alien/Legends|alien]] dignitaries in the early days of his tenure. After receiving coaching in diplomatic protocol, the senator issued formal apologies and gained allies in those he had slighted.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Just Remember Everyone's Name}}</ref>
